_comment: Golden State: what was done to this TV, not what version its apps are. Apps update all the time, so third-party app versions are NOT tracked here: a package is verified by presence only (check: presence), and its apk/sha256 are the install source provision uses when the app is missing, hash-checked before install, never compared against the TV. The one exception is the CleanTV launcher (check: exact): it is his own build, its version IS the QoL work, and provision installs exactly that build. The `tweaks` section records the actual work: plugins, add-ons, settings, DNS, ad blocking, video-player/browser-wrapper work, and launcher QoL. Do not hand-edit; re-run capture after changing anything on the TV.

what: Circular navigation: left from the first tile wraps to the last tile, right from the last wraps to the first (Home.java focusSearch).

Dim toggle: one-click Dim chip on the home screen; Guard accessibility overlay, 80% black (alpha 204, SmartTube paused-idle level), TRANSLUCENT, NOT_FOCUSABLE/NOT_TOUCHABLE, stays until untoggled, works while media plays. System brightness is NOT used: it does not move this TCL panel's backlight.
Guard accessibility service (tv.cleantv.home/tv.cleantv.home.Guard) takes HOME from Amazon's launcher. Any launcher force-stop/restart must rebind Guard afterward; a plain am start does not.
home.conf: dim_mode=off, dim=40 (image dim), rotate=visit, custom tile order, labels=focus, clock=auto.
personalDNSfilter (dnsfilter.android) runs as an always-on local VPN on the TV (settings always_on_vpn_app=dnsfilter.android, autostart on).
Blocklist is HaGeZi Amazon-only trackers plus data/blocklists/extra-hosts.txt and alexa-hosts.txt; Alexa hosts blocked. No general blocklists: they would risk the streaming apps for almost no gain.
dnsfilter.conf: detectDNS=false, routeUnderlyingDNS=true, fallbackDNS is the router (or DNS_UPSTREAM when set), filter auto-update disabled. SYSTEM_DNS=0 (Fire OS 7 keeps its clock without it).
SmartTube (org.smarttube.stable): a reimplementation with no ad code, ads are never requested. DNS filtering cannot block YouTube ads (same hosts as video).

S0undTV / Twitch: Server-Side Ad Insertion stitches ads into the playlist, so DNS blocking shows a purple/black screen. The fix is the S0undTV Proxy URL (Luminous proxy): only the playlist request goes through the proxy, video segments come straight from Twitch's CDN. Since S0undTV beta_147 (self-updated 2026-11-04), the proxy URLs MUST end with &fast_bread=true or low-latency streams fall back to direct Twitch playlists with ads.
Kick / Rumble ads come from their own CDNs alongside content: blocking is partial and frequently breaks playback, not worth the fragility.
ad_blocking.settings_source: private/app-settings/app-settings.ab (SmartTube ad/SponsorBlock/shorts settings, S0undTV Luminous proxy slots) — restore is opt-in, unverified on another TV

what: WebView wrapper shells in apps/webwrap (frameXTV, ObbyWatcher): native MotionEvent taps and ACTION_HOVER_MOVE that reach into iframes and count as genuine user activation; container fullscreen pin that keeps the player's own controls; DPR scale derived from innerWidth (panel 3840x2160, Fire OS app layer 1920x1080).
Removed Nov 7, 2026 as deprecated (uninstalled from the TV): MMABite, StreamEast, AnimeHeaven, Miruro wrappers.
Wrapper source is the tweak: apps/webwrap (apps.txt, build.sh). Installed wrapper versions are not pinned; presence is what is checked.

Removed Nov 7, 2026 as deprecated (uninstalled from the TV): Watchbox plus its six Aniyomi extension APKs and the Watchbox repo deep link; CloudStream plus its phisher98/recloudstream extension repos; Arvio plus its add-ons (Torrentio, Comet, Flix-Streams Free, HdHub, OpenSubtitles v3); Lumera plus its add-ons (Cinemeta, Torrentio, Comet, OpenSubtitles v3, MediaFusion, Flix-Streams Free, HdHub).
Zangetsu: nine installed providers (AniKoto, 4K HDHub, UHD Movies, HDHub4u, HiAnime, VegaMovies, MultiMovies, AnimeCube, TorBox) from the zangetsu-providers index; TorBox needs its key re-entered.
Atlantic: content plugin is built into the APK, nothing to provision.

Lumora: live-TV/plugin shell (com.lumora 7.1). 5th tile in home.conf. JS plugins (Anime Senshi, Torrent Search, Reddit IPTV Scanner, Streaming Site List), Stremio add-ons (Cinemeta, WatchHub, OpenSubtitles v3, Torrentio, MediaFusion, Comet, AIOStreams), the epg6 guide, and the obnoxious.lol Jellyfin/ObnoxiousTV integration are manual in-app steps — full list in provision/lumora/README.md. Debrid keys, the Jellyfin account and the ObnoxiousTV manifest are his to supply, never committed. MMA/motorsports sports-tab code change is a patch in provision/lumora/ (BUILD.md); the live TV still runs stock v7.1 until a patched build ships.
home.conf (apps/home.conf): tile order, dim, dim_mode, rotate, labels, clock, inputs, hidden tiles, HDMI renames (PlayStation 5, PC).
Wallpaper apps/wallpapers/dark-waves.jpg; tile art in apps/art.
39 Amazon packages disabled (disabled_packages) plus CleanTV debloat/lockdown in cleantv/scripts/all.sh.
settings: always_on_vpn_app=dnsfilter.android, alarm_manager_constants min_futurity=0, enabled_accessibility_services includes the CleanTV Guard.
Aerial Views is the idle screensaver (not the dim).
